<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_NewProductDevelopment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/new-product-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_NewProductDevelopment" name="New Product or Improvement Development" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IdeaIdentified" name="Product or improvement idea identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductResearch" name="Conduct initial research and feasibility studies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftDesigns" name="Draft design concepts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select promising design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype using available materials and resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestMerge" name="Prototype ready for testing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestPrototype" name="Test prototype for functionality, safety and market potential">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect feedback from testing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" name="Refinement needed?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Outcome" name="Prototype outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Prototype approved for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Discarded" name="Prototype discarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IdeaIdentified" targetRef="Task_ConductResearch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_ConductResearch" targetRef="Task_DraftDesigns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_DraftDesigns" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_TestMerge" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_TestPrototype" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="EndEvent_Discarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
